name: coss
description: Build with coss.com (email, marketing, inboxes, SMS, Verify, Sign, Forms, Scheduling, Hooks, Risk): a skill for adding it to a project, and the MCP server that searches the docs and explains deliveries

api_key.title: coss.com API key
api_key.description: For the MCP server: a development key (coss_test_…), e.g. from `npx coss-cli init`. Leave empty to use only its docs tools.

toolsets.title: MCP toolsets
toolsets.description: Offer fewer MCP tools, which saves context: a comma-separated list of email, marketing, inboxes, sms, verify, sign, forms, scheduling, webhooks, hooks and risk. The docs, setup, logs and account tools are always there. Leave empty for every tool.
